[REFERENCE] 2. The patient has been experiencing recurrent episodes lasting 3–4 minutes each of facial grimacing and staring over the past month.

[REFERENCE] 5. He reports a muddy taste in his mouth before the onset of these episodes.  
[REFERENCE] 6. His brother witnessed him waking up, staring, and making hand gestures during one episode.

[RESPONSE] I’ve been having strange episodes for about a month—about 3 to 4 minutes long—where my face twitches or grimaces, I stare off, and I don’t respond to anyone. Afterward, I feel tired and confused.
